description: Freeze time in a scratch arena; reset the Wither to (15,80,15) and zero velocity before each single tick. A NoAI villager with Resistance V stands at (15+dx,82.19,15), placing its half-eye target next to the main firing head (15,83,15). Kill old skulls before each tick. Inspect Motion and Pos of a newly launched main-head skull within 60 ticks. Repeat each case twice. Compare direction and the zero vector, since projectile speed/flight is a separate upstream change.
